stops.name: Nebel
stops.detail: In total, there are 60 lakes in the nature park; the rivers Nebel and Mildenitz originate here.

stops.name: Kloster Dobbertin
stops.detail: The Dobbertin Abbey is also located near the nature park.

days.title: Wildlife and Ice Age Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Damerower Werder
stops.detail: The fact that European bison are bred on the Damerower Werder contributes to the conservation of this wild cattle species that was once native to Central Europe and is now threatened with extinction.

stops.name: Sander
stops.detail: A special feature of the nature park are the sandur, leftover sand and gravel deposits from the Ice Age.

stops.name: Moore
stops.detail: Numerous moors also characterize the landscape.
